The '''Aar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Nijune sector/Legends|Nijune sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aar]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in space controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
